headline: Iran billboard shows Trump and family in coffins as 'blood for blood'
summary: Tehran reports at least 50 people killed in US strikes over the last month, fueling tensions between the two nations.
details: A billboard in Iran has appeared featuring images of Donald Trump and members of his family in coffins, accompanied by the slogan 'blood for blood'.
This provocative display comes amid escalating tensions between Iran and the United States.
Tehran has reported that at least 50 people have been killed in US strikes over the past month.
The billboard serves as a visual manifestation of the anger and desire for retaliation following these military actions.

headline_marked: USA: [[Argentina-Spain match to be most expensive sports final]] in US history
headline: USA: Argentina-Spain match to be most expensive sports final in US history
summary: The high-stakes clash between Argentina and Spain is set to become the costliest sporting event final in the United States, as both teams prepare for the historic showdown.
details: The upcoming final between Argentina and Spain is projected to be the most expensive sports final in the history of the United States.
Spain's head coach Luis de la Fuente (referred to as Del Bosque in some reports) has warned that Argentina's strengths are a major threat to his team's success.
Spanish midfielder Rodri has emphasized that Spain needs to improve their performance further to secure a victory over the opponents.
The match is set to be a clash of titans, with Lionel Messi's Argentina and the rising stars of Spain, including Lamine Yamal, facing off for the glory.
Adding to the personal stakes, Argentina's coach Scaloni's Spanish wife and children are now the center of attention regarding which team they will support.
Lionel Messi has shared an emotional video ahead of the final, reflecting the weight and importance of the match for his footballing legacy.
There are also reports of Spanish players seeking assistance from Donald Trump to gain entry into the United States for the tournament.
caption:
The most expensive sports final in US history! ⚽️

The upcoming final between Argentina and Spain is projected to be the most expensive sports final in the history of the United States.

Spain's head coach Luis de la Fuente (referred to as Del Bosque in some reports) has warned that Argentina's strengths are a major threat to his team's success.

Spanish midfielder Rodri has emphasized that Spain needs to improve their performance further to secure a victory over the opponents.

The match is set to be a clash of titans, with Lionel Messi's Argentina and the rising stars of Spain, including Lamine Yamal, facing off for the glory.

Adding to the personal stakes, Argentina's coach Scaloni's Spanish wife and children are now the center of attention regarding which team they will support.

Lionel Messi has shared an emotional video ahead of the final, reflecting the weight and importance of the match for his footballing legacy.

There are also reports of Spanish players seeking assistance from Donald Trump to gain entry into the United States for the tournament.

Source: Somoy News, Prothom Alo
